data.exact_reserve_text: As at 31 December 2020, Syndicate 1110 is declaring a profit of GBP 5.9m (2019: loss of GBP 0.2m) of which GBP 7.9m is attributable to 2020 year of account, partially offset by losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively.

prior_year_events.impact_description: losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 0.588 million in 2020, representing 0.44% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was primarily driven by adverse claims development on the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account, which contributed net losses of GBP 0.1 million and GBP 1.9 million respectively.
raw_causal_phrases: losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior_year_development_gbp_m is calculated from the gross claims development triangle, as the narrative text only provides a net profit/loss breakdown by year of account, not a gross reserve movement. The claims development triangle on page 10 is missing the 2018 underwriting year. The exact_reserve_text describes the net profit/loss by year of account, not the gross prior year reserve movement.
